name: steamwand.js
description: TypeScript bindings for the Steamworks SDK, generated from steam_api.json over the flat C API via koffi FFI. No native compilation.
author: Joel Deffner

scripts.test:live: cross-env STEAM_LIVE=1 STEAM_LIVE_WRITE=0 vitest run test/live --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:live:write: cross-env STEAM_LIVE=1 STEAM_LIVE_WRITE=1 vitest run test/live --exclude test/live/workshop.live.test.ts --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:workshop: cross-env STEAM_LIVE=1 STEAM_LIVE_WRITE=1 vitest run test/live/workshop.live.test.ts --no-file-parallelism
